<div class="pvme-exact-guide">
<h1 id="mid-game-combat" class="pvme-source-title"><nowiki>Mid game combat</nowiki></h1>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="introduction"><ins><nowiki>Introduction</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>This channel is intended as a guide for players looking to progress towards the tougher challenges RS3 PvM offers.</nowiki></strong><nowiki> It covers skill goals to set on your PvM journey, how to improve your damage and useful unlocks for your PvM experience.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="preparation"><ins><nowiki>Preparation</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Before you begin, it can be helpful to get a few things out of the way:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Set up a good interface - see </nowiki><span><nowiki>#interface-guide</nowiki></span><nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Learn about the different combat modes (Revolution and Full Manual) - </nowiki><span><nowiki>#revo-to-full-manual</nowiki></span><nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Have a peek at the </nowiki><span><nowiki>#bossing-path</nowiki></span><nowiki> that you can work on as you learn PvM.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="initial-goals"><ins><nowiki>Initial Goals</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Having an idea of some of the things you want to aim for initially can help with planning, which we cover here. </nowiki><strong><nowiki>None of these things are strictly necessary, but are recommended to make your bossing learning curves an easier and more enjoyable experience.</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="skill-goals"><nowiki>Skill Goals</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Achieving these goals will significantly improve the variety of combat content you can successfully complete. Some suggestions on how to achieve each skilling goal can be found in </nowiki><span><nowiki>#noncombat-skilling-guide</nowiki></span></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Level 90+ Combat Stats</nowiki></strong><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250472476758.png?v=1" alt="Attack" title="Attack" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250879324165.png?v=1" alt="Strength" title="Strength" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1" alt="Magic" title="Magic" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1" alt="range" title="range" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250979987525.png?v=1" alt="Defence" title="Defence" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1" alt="necromancy" title="necromancy" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Improves hitchance, damage, defences and survivability, and ensure you have all relevant abilities unlocked.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Level 95+ Prayer</nowiki></strong><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1005450651347730533.png?v=1" alt="prayer" title="prayer" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Soul Split </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615613924506599497.png?v=1" alt="soulsplit" title="soulsplit" kind="icon" /><nowiki> for healing at 92</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Damage-boosting curses </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/583429936606347280.png?v=1" alt="turmoil" title="turmoil" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/583429936665198592.png?v=1" alt="anguish" title="anguish" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/583429936958930964.png?v=1" alt="torment" title="torment" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137941003895046284.png?v=1" alt="sorrow" title="sorrow" kind="icon" /><nowiki> at 95</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Level 89/99 Herblore</nowiki></strong><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689554435583508558.png?v=1" alt="Herblore" title="Herblore" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Can boost from 89 (+7 pulse core </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1005450653390360626.png?v=1" alt="pulsecore" title="pulsecore" kind="icon" /><nowiki> boost) to make overloads </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689554436179361864.png?v=1" alt="ovl" title="ovl" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and use the Request Assist feature to make adrenaline renewals </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/736298121704767538.png?v=1" alt="adrenrenewal" title="adrenrenewal" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Can boost from 99 (with </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1005450653390360626.png?v=1" alt="pulsecore" title="pulsecore" kind="icon" /><nowiki>) to make elder overloads </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/841419289831800882.png?v=1" alt="elderovl" title="elderovl" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, which have +4 stats over regular overloads.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Level 68+ Invention</nowiki></strong><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250946695292.png?v=1" alt="Invention" title="Invention" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Enough to get the </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Starter Perks</nowiki></strong><nowiki> in </nowiki><span><nowiki>#perks</nowiki></span><nowiki> (with help of extreme potion </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1032540072169439242.png?v=1" alt="extremeinventionpotion" title="extremeinventionpotion" kind="icon" /><nowiki>)</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Starter perks are good enough to use until you reach 120 Invention and attempt advanced perks.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Summoning </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/583430259064569856.png?v=1" alt="Summoning" title="Summoning" kind="icon" /><nowiki> - no set level</nowiki></strong><nowiki> but some useful familiars are:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Hellhound </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/921410226475925514.png?v=1" alt="hellhoundpouch" title="hellhoundpouch" kind="icon" /><nowiki> - at 45</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• War Tortoise </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513195712222068737.png?v=1" alt="Tortoise" title="Tortoise" kind="icon" /><nowiki> - at 67</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Talon Beast - at 77</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Nihils </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/854475442169053194.png?v=1" alt="bloodnihil" title="bloodnihil" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/854475441946230855.png?v=1" alt="shadownihil" title="shadownihil" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/854475442227642388.png?v=1" alt="smokenihil" title="smokenihil" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/854475442164334592.png?v=1" alt="icenihil" title="icenihil" kind="icon" /><nowiki>- at 89</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Kalgerion Demon </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/921410226484301925.png?v=1" alt="kalgpouch" title="kalgpouch" kind="icon" /><nowiki> - at 90</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Pack Yak </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513195712201228289.png?v=1" alt="Yak" title="Yak" kind="icon" /><nowiki> - at 96</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Ripper Demons </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/703581275453128714.png?v=1" alt="ripperpouch" title="ripperpouch" kind="icon" /><nowiki> - at 96</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="mid-high-level-training"><ins><nowiki>Mid-High Level </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896050370281523.png?v=1" alt="combat" title="combat" kind="icon" /><nowiki> training</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>The suggestions outlined below are intended for audiences wishing to go from level 50 through to 99/120 in their favourite </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896050370281523.png?v=1" alt="combat" title="combat" kind="icon" /><nowiki> styles.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Level 50/60-80:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Abyss/Combat_training <nowiki>The Abyss Monsters</nowiki>]<nowiki> (req. </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Enter_the_Abyss_(miniquest)/Quick_guide <nowiki>Enter the Abyss miniquest</nowiki>]<nowiki>). Use AoE, </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1052551452788269127.png?v=1" alt="protectfrommelee" title="protectfrommelee" kind="icon" /><nowiki> if possible.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Armoured_zombie <nowiki>Armoured Zombies</nowiki>]<nowiki> (req. </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Defender_of_Varrock/Quick_guide <nowiki>Defender of Varrock quest</nowiki>]<nowiki>, </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797899945730244648.png?v=1" alt="salveamulet" title="salveamulet" kind="icon" /><nowiki> works!).</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Level 80+:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><em><nowiki>Worth checking </nowiki><span><nowiki>#rs3-slayer</nowiki></span><nowiki> for methods (downscale gear as necessary)</nowiki></em><nowiki>:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Ravenous_ghoul <nowiki>Ravenous Ghouls</nowiki>]<nowiki> in the crypts below the graveyard north of Canifis.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Vyrewatch <nowiki>Vyrewatch</nowiki>]<nowiki> (req. </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Branches_of_Darkmeyer <nowiki>Branches of Darkmeyer</nowiki>]<nowiki>) </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/River_of_Blood/Quick_guide <nowiki>River of Blood quest</nowiki>]<nowiki> recommended for sunspear (pvme guide :</nowiki><span><nowiki>#unknown-channel</nowiki></span><nowiki>).</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Bound_skeleton <nowiki>Bound Skeletons</nowiki>]<nowiki> north of Fort Forinthry.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1" alt="range" title="range" kind="icon" /><nowiki>: </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Abyssal_savage <nowiki>Abyssal Savages</nowiki>]<nowiki> (req. 95 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1" alt="slayer" title="slayer" kind="icon" /><nowiki>) in Wilderness or Senntisten Asylum (pvme guide: </nowiki><span><nowiki>#unknown-channel</nowiki></span><nowiki>).</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Level 95+ (</nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1" alt="melee" title="melee" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1" alt="magic" title="magic" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1" alt="necromancy" title="necromancy" kind="icon" /><nowiki>):</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Abyssal_beast <nowiki>Abyssal Beasts</nowiki>]<nowiki> (req. 105 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1" alt="slayer" title="slayer" kind="icon" /><nowiki>) in Wilderness or Senntisten Asylum (pvme guide: </nowiki><span><nowiki>#unknown-channel</nowiki></span><nowiki>).</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Armoured_phantom <nowiki>Armoured Phantoms</nowiki>]<nowiki> (req. 113 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1" alt="slayer" title="slayer" kind="icon" /><nowiki>) (pvme guide: </nowiki><span><nowiki>#unknown-channel</nowiki></span><nowiki>).</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="bossing"><ins><nowiki>Bossing</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ If you are particularly interested in bossing, </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Soul_Reaper <nowiki>reaper tasks</nowiki>]<nowiki> are a daily activity where Death asks you to kill a certain boss. This is a good way to experience different bosses.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ You can also check out </nowiki><span><nowiki>#bossing-path</nowiki></span><nowiki> to set some bossing goals.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Basic guides for most bosses in Runescape can be found in </nowiki><span><nowiki>#unknown-channel</nowiki></span><nowiki>. These guides have beginner preset recommendations, an overview of the boss's mechanics, and suggestions for how to deal with them.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="improving-damage-output"><ins><nowiki>Improving Damage Output</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>In RuneScape, the best defence is a great offence. Improving your damage output will significantly increase your chances of success at whichever boss or slayer task you're trying to accomplish. There are little things you can do to optimise once you reach that stage, but initially there are three core ways to increase your damage output:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Upgrading your gear setup</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Assuming a starting point of T70 weapons and T70 armour, </nowiki><span><nowiki>#upgrade-order</nowiki></span><nowiki> will help you upgrade your gear progressively for each combat style.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Improving your DPS rotation</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• For strong revolution bars with various degrees of ability unlocks, check out </nowiki><span><nowiki>#revolution-bars</nowiki></span></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• For learning to switch to full manual gameplay, check out </nowiki><span><nowiki>#revo-to-full-manual</nowiki></span></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• For learning how to start improving your DPM, check out </nowiki><span><nowiki>#dpm-advice</nowiki></span></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• For help and advice, the Helpers and Super Helpers can answer your questions in </nowiki><span><nowiki>#pvm-help</nowiki></span></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Useful permanent unlocks</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Permanent unlocks have a multitude of benefits ranging from adrenaline refunds on abilities to enchantments on weapons/gear. For a full list of recommendations, check out </nowiki><span><nowiki>#permanent-unlocks</nowiki></span></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
      
    </nowiki>

</div>
</div>
